import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPS = ROOM;

    static int[][] station = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] checkpoint = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] veneno; // will be allocated after reading T and N

    static int[] moveX = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] moveY = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static class Aresta {
        int from, to, rev, flow, cap;
        Aresta(int _from, int _to, int _rev, int _flow, int _cap) {
            from = _from; to = _to; rev = _rev; flow = _flow; cap = _cap;
        }
        int residuo() { return cap - flow; }
    }

    static class EdmondsKarp {
        int size;
        ArrayList<Aresta>[] grafo;
        Aresta[] prev;
        boolean[] vis;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        EdmondsKarp(int tam) {
            size = tam;
            grafo = new ArrayList[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) grafo[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            prev = new Aresta[size];
            vis = new boolean[size];
        }

        void add(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, 0);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        void undirectedAdd(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, cap);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(prev, null);
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Queue<Integer> fila = new LinkedList<>();
            fila.add(source);
            vis[source] = true;
            while (!fila.isEmpty()) {
                int atual = fila.poll();
                if (atual == sink) return true;
                for (Aresta a : grafo[atual]) {
                    if (!vis[a.to] && a.residuo() > 0) {
                        prev[a.to] = a;
                        vis[a.to] = true;
                        fila.add(a.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int dfs(int source, int sink) {
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int v = sink;
            while (v != source) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, prev[v].residuo());
                v = prev[v].from;
            }
            v = sink;
            while (v != source) {
                Aresta a = prev[v];
                a.flow += flow;
                grafo[a.to].get(a.rev).flow -= flow;
                v = a.from;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        long flow(int source, int sink) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(source, sink)) {
                total += dfs(source, sink);
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static class Coord {
        int x, y, qtd;
        Coord(int a, int b, int c) {
            x = a; y = b; qtd = c;
        }
        boolean isValid(int N) {
            return x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && station[x][y] == ROOM;
        }
    }

    static boolean isValid(int x, int y, int N) {
        return new Coord(x, y, 0).isValid(N);
    }

    static int trad(char ch) {
        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') return ROOM;
        if (ch == 'Y') return REAC;
        if (ch == 'Z') return BAD_REAC;
        return -1;
    }

    static int howMuch(char ch) {
        return ch - '0';
    }

    static int bfs(Coord from, Coord to, int N) {
        boolean[][] vis = new boolean[N][N];
        Queue<int[]> fila = new LinkedList<>();
        fila.add(new int[]{0, from.x, from.y});
        vis[from.x][from.y] = true;
        while (!fila.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = fila.poll();
            int tempo = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1], y = cur[2];
            if (x == to.x && y == to.y) return tempo;
            if (veneno[tempo][x][y] == 1) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + moveX[i];
                int ny = y + moveY[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && station[nx][ny] == ROOM && !vis[nx][ny]) {
                    if (veneno[tempo][nx][ny] == 0) {
                        fila.add(new int[]{tempo + 1, nx, ny});
                        vis[nx][ny] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static void espalhaVeneno(int x, int y, int T, int N) {
        veneno[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) {
            for (int lin = 0; lin < N; lin++) {
                for (int col = 0; col < N; col++) {
                    if (veneno[i-1][lin][col] == 1) {
                        veneno[i][lin][col] = 1;
                        for (int move = 0; move < 4; move++) {
                            int nx = lin + moveX[move];
                            int ny = col + moveY[move];
                            if (isValid(nx, ny, N)) {
                                veneno[i][nx][ny] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // allocate veneno with T+1 layers (since we use up to T)
        veneno = new int[T+1][N][N];

        List<Coord> pessoas = new ArrayList<>();
        Coord bad = new Coord(0, 0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (trad(ch) == ROOM && howMuch(ch) > 0) {
                    pessoas.add(new Coord(i, j, howMuch(ch)));
                }
                station[i][j] = trad(ch);
                if (station[i][j] == BAD_REAC) {
                    bad = new Coord(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        List<Coord> capsulas = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (trad(ch) == CAPS && howMuch(ch) > 0) {
                    capsulas.add(new Coord(i, j, howMuch(ch)));
                    checkpoint[i][j] = howMuch(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        EdmondsKarp din = new EdmondsKarp(MAXN);
        int sink = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < pessoas.size(); i++) {
            din.add(0, i*2+1, pessoas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < capsulas.size(); i++) {
            din.add(i*2+2, sink, capsulas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        espalhaVeneno(bad.x, bad.y, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < pessoas.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < capsulas.size(); j++) {
                int tempo = bfs(pessoas.get(i), capsulas.get(j), N);
                if (tempo <= T) {
                    din.add(i*2+1, j*2+2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(din.flow(0, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
